notes.title: Crawlers update
notes.notes:
The new features are available now, which include new types of creatures that appear underground.

Whats new:
A new Research for rotating underground gun.
Rotating underground gun.
Crawler Queen which build a nest for other crawler to move through it.
Crawler Melee which attack target within its range.
Light can be used to dissolve crawler nest.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35715978/8a4f7cdffa316808540605b927e321429c2fb3fa.png[/img]


Other improvements for memory usage and audio.

notes.title: Survival Vacancy is out of Early access
notes.notes:
After the game has been passed through a lot of updates and improvements,I see now it is ready to be out of early access.
Thanks to all early supporters,who give feedback and reporting bugs,the game won't make it this far without your support and help.
Out of early access doesn't mean the end of the development,more updates and content will be added.
Feedback and suggestions are welcome to further enhance the overall experience of the game.

notes.title: 2-Feb-2021 Update
notes.notes:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: New technologies
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adding new technologies to research tree.
[*] Replace large population requirements for research with specific skilled survivors.
[*] New items "[i]Coal battery[/i]","[i]High density coal battery[/i]" and "[i]Long range teleporter[/i]".

notes.title: Supercharge your productivity
notes.notes:
Now you can design a reusable layout.
Drag and select your design and save it as reusable production line.
Use it as many times as you want and you can share it with friends.
No need to reconfigure your input and output ports.
Make sure you have the required structures in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35715978/a1777e2078419b52623b103943d76d60800c7b67.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35715978/bbb7638f152db39e2cbaa3f9230b752c94ae4ee1.gif[/img]

notes.title: New machines, Teleporters and Radiation Stabilizer
notes.notes:
New machines
Radiation Stabilizer - use Rad Pill Compound to remove radiation from survivors in range.
Teleporter - used to teleport items to other location to avoid rail traffic congestion,check the video.
Zone teleporter - used to teleport items between different zones.

Quality of life improvements
Range Visulaizer for Shelters,Guns,Radiation Stabilizer and Teleporters.

Multiplayer
Add selecting server region UI.
the players should connect to the same region to see each other.

[previewyoutube=UnmqlLQYxkE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 10 months have passed since the release of Early access.
notes.notes:
[h2]Here is a brief list of what have been done :[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mutants and defense structures.[/b]
[*][b]Several new machines for transporting items and logistics.[/b]
[olist]
[*] Transporter
[*] Station
[*] Transporter Track
[*] Recycler

[*] Large storage
[/olist]
[*][b]Improved Radiation dynamics.[/b]
[*][b]Survivors avatars with free relocation.[/b]
[*][b]Production reports.[/b]
[*][b]Travel to new zones to explore new world with new resources "features of new zones still in development".[/b]
[*][b]Creative mode with all techs unlocked.[/b]
[*][b]A group of achievements have been added "More achievements will be added".[/b]
[*][b]Multiplayer "still in beta".[/b]
[*][b]Localization in German-French-Spanish-Russian-Brazillian.[/b]
[*][b]Overall performance and UX improvements.[/b]
[/list]


[h3][b]A lot more will be coming.
Thank you all who supported the game in this early stage.[/b][/h3]

notes.notes:
Unlock filtered storage.
Use filtered storage to accept desired items only.
Filtered storage will help organize carrier operations.
This update also contains overall performance improvements for large bases.

Chance of getting an item will be affected by worker skills who assigned to the recycler.

[list]
[*] Large storage boxes is available now

[*]
